highlights.title: New start page and Overview
highlights.detail: The app opens on Transactions. Dashboard, Insights and Items are now one Overview page.

highlights.title: Search everywhere
highlights.detail: One search box in the top bar searches every page. Press / or ⌘F to use it.

highlights.title: Rolling periods
highlights.detail: The period picker has the last 7, 30, 90 and 365 days. Each compares with the days before.
